# SGRHP

> SGRHP is a multi-tenant SaaS platform by Cible RH Emploi S.A. (Cameroon) for HR administration, payroll, invoicing, accounting (OHADA), inventory and quality management (ISO 9001). Access is restricted to authenticated client organisations.

## About
- Operator: Cible RH Emploi S.A., Cameroon
- Product: SGRHP (Systeme de Gestion RH et Paie) - HR, payroll, invoicing, accounting, stock and quality
- Access: private, login required per client organisation (multi-tenant, data isolated per organisation)

## Pages
- [Home / Sign in](/): application entry and authentication
- [Terms of Service](/): available in-app and on the sign-in screen
- [Privacy Policy](/): available in-app and on the sign-in screen

## Notes
- This is a private business application, not a public content site. Most functionality is behind authentication.
- For information or access requests, contact Cible RH Emploi S.A.
